name: Teton River (Driggs)
gaugeName: Teton River ab South Leigh Creek nr Driggs
blurb: Teton Valley meadow floats near Driggs, from Fox Creek through South Bates, Buxton River Park and Big Eddy to Packsaddle and Harrops. Choose a short paddle or link adjoining reaches; the technical canyon begins below Harrops.

sections.difficulty: Class I; wood and conditions vary
sections.notes: Start at the designated Fox Creek West access. The guide groups the east and west Fox Creek launches together; actual launch connections vary. Arrange a shuttle to South Bates (Nickerson) before launching.

takeOutAccess.note: Agency point lies in the small staging area beside the ramp and bridge. The recreation guide identifies Harrops as the end of the upper meadow floats. Keep it an approximate facility point, not an exact shoreline pin.

timing.note: Published paddling times are available for these reaches. The former reference-flow speed has no documented trip calibration; guide times are not live ETAs and do not change with the selected craft, fishing stops or current flow.
